title: Dimitry Danilovich Fokin And Larisa Vasilievna Kravchenko Alias

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & F. REGISTRY
No. D 3802
Special Branch S. 2. Section
Date 25 / 6 / 32
June 1st, 1932

Subject (in full) Dimitry Danilovich Fokin and Larisa Vasilievna Kravchenko
alias Kravchenkova.

Made by D.S. Tcheremansky. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached article from The
Shanghai Sunday Times" of June 19, 1932 entitled "Famous Russian
Dancers," enquiries made regarding the matter show that the
ballet dancers mentioned in this article are Mr. D.D. Fokin and
Miss L.V. Kravchenko alias Kravchenkova who arrived in Shanghai
from Harbin via Dairen on June 16, 1932 by the s.s. "Dairen
Maru." They are in possession of Emigrants passports issued
by the Kirin Diplomatic Bureau on June 6, 1932. The above-
mentioned artists came to Shanghai from Harbin at the invitation
of one M.E. Morgenstern, Hungarian, an employee of the Peacock
Motion Picture Corp. 21 Museum Road, with whom they have since
signed an agreement for one year. Fokin and Kravchenko reside
at 326 Rue Cardinal Mercier at the house of their impresario
Morgenstern.

During the course of an interview with the ballet dancers
the following was learned :-

Dimitry Danilivich Fokin-Pahomoff is a Russian 30 years
of age, and a native of Tambov Province. He is the son of
a farmer and from early childhood resided with his parents in
Astrakhan. He was educated in a Tradee School and later in a
Private Ballet school where he remained with the support of his
elder brother. In 1918 he joined the "Volga Flotilla" of the
White Russian Navy. He was wounded in action near the Kazan
and recuperated the Kazan and Samara hospitals. Discharged from
hospital he returned to his parents at Astrakhan but during the
journey was arrested and imprisoned for 1½ months in Wolsk as
a suspected "White" but was later released under an amnesty on the
on the anniversary of the October Revolution, and then proceeded
to Astrakhan.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与指纹登记处
编号 D 3802
特务科 S. 2. 组
日期 1932年6月25日
1932年6月1日

事由（全称） 德米特里·达尼洛维奇·福金（Dimitry Danilovich Fokin）及拉里萨·瓦西里耶夫娜·克拉夫琴科（Larisa Vasilievna Kravchenko），又名克拉夫琴科娃（Kravchenkova）。

制作人：D.S. 切列曼斯基（Tcheremansky）。呈送人：[签名]

关于随附的1932年6月19日《上海星期泰晤士报》（The Shanghai Sunday Times）上题为“著名俄国舞蹈家”的文章，经就此事项进行调查，结果显示该文中提到的芭蕾舞演员为 D.D. 福金先生和 L.V. 克拉夫琴科小姐（又名克拉夫琴科娃），他们于1932年6月16日乘坐“大连丸”号轮船（s.s. "Dairen Maru"）经大连从哈尔滨抵达上海。他们持有吉林外交局于1932年6月6日签发的移民护照。上述艺术家应匈牙利人 M.E. 莫根斯特恩（Morgenstern）之邀从哈尔滨来到上海，此人是位于博物馆路21号的孔雀电影公司（Peacock Motion Picture Corp.）雇员，他们随后与其签订了一份为期一年的合同。福金和克拉夫琴科居住在他们的经理人莫根斯特恩家中，地址为梅爱赫神父路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）326号。

在与芭蕾舞演员面谈过程中，获悉以下情况：

德米特里·达尼洛维奇·福金-帕霍莫夫（Dimitry Danilivich Fokin-Pahomoff）是俄罗斯人，现年30岁，坦波夫省（Tambov Province）人。他是农民之子，自幼随父母居住在阿斯特拉罕（Astrakhan）。他就读于一所贸易学校，后来进入一所私立芭蕾学校学习，期间由其兄长资助。1918年，他加入白俄海军的“伏尔加区舰队”（Volga Flotilla）。他在喀山（Kazan）附近作战时受伤，并在喀山和萨马拉（Samara）的医院疗养。出院后，他返回阿斯特拉罕的父母身边，但在途中因涉嫌为“白党”分子而在沃尔斯克（Wolsk）被捕并监禁了一个半月，后来在十月革命周年纪念大赦下获释，随后前往阿斯特拉罕。

From 1919 onwards for the next three years he was
employed as a ballet dancer in a government theatre at Baku,
Kavkaz.

From 1923 to 1930 he was employed as a ballet dancer and
ballet master in various towns in south and middle Russia and
Turkestan. Periodically he visited Moscow for training in the
Great Moscow Theatre Ballet School. In September, 1930 he left
for Vladivostok. Here he was employed for two months in the
State Theatre. In November 1931 he made an attempt to escape from
U.S.S.R., but was arrested by the Frontier Guard of G.P.U. near
village Strigovka. He was imprisoned in Nikolsk-Ussuriysk and
Vladivostok for several months and in April 1932 was charged with
attempting an illegal crossing of the boundary and was sentenced
to $100 fine.

After his release he was working casually as a ballet
dancer in various clubs and theatres. In July 1931 Fokin made
a second and successful attempt to escape from U.S.S.R. and
crossed boundary near Grodekovo and Pogranichnaia stations.
After his arrival in Harbin he was casually employed in local
theatres. In November 1931 he organized the escape of his
partner L.V. Kravchenko with the assistance of a smugglers
organization. From December to February he was employed at the
Cabaret "Fantasia" and from March 1931 he again worked casually
and also owned a ballet school. During the early part of June
he was engaged by Morgenstern as mentioned in the first part of
this report.

Larisa Vasillievna Kravchenko alias Kravchenkova, is
a Russian being born in 1908 in Ust - Medyadizkaye, Don Prov.
She is the daughter of a clergyman of Cossack origin. In 1918

从1919年起，在接下来的三年里，他在高加索地区巴库（Baku, Kavkaz）的一家政府剧院担任芭蕾舞演员。

从1923年到1930年，他在俄罗斯南部和中部以及突厥斯坦（Turkestan）的各个城镇担任芭蕾舞演员和芭蕾指导。他定期前往莫斯科，在莫斯科大剧院芭蕾学校接受训练。1930年9月，他前往符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostok）。在那里，他在国家剧院工作了两个月。1931年11月，他试图逃离苏联，但在斯特里戈夫卡村（Strigovka）附近被国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）的边防警卫逮捕。他在尼古拉斯克-乌苏里斯基（Nikolsk-Ussuriysk）和符拉迪沃斯托克被监禁数月，并于1932年4月被指控企图非法越境，被判处罚款100美元。

获释后，他在各家俱乐部和剧院临时担任芭蕾舞演员。1931年7月，福金第二次尝试逃离苏联并获得成功，在格罗杰科沃（Grodekovo）和波格拉尼奇纳亚（Pogranichnaia）车站附近越过边界。抵达哈尔滨后，他在当地剧院临时受雇。1931年11月，他在一个走私组织的协助下，策划其搭档 L.V. 克拉夫琴科出逃。从12月到2月，他在“幻想”歌舞厅（Cabaret "Fantasia"）工作，从1931年3月起，他再次从事临时工作，并拥有一所芭蕾学校。6月上旬，正如本报告第一部分所述，他被莫根斯特恩聘用。

her parents left for Kazan where her father was studying in a
Ecclesiastical Academy. In 1916 she accompanied her parents to
Baku Kavkaz to which place her father had been transferred.
In 1917, owing to bad health she left with her mother for Vologda,
North Russia, but returned to Perm after the commencement of the
civil war. In 1918 her father was arrested and sentenced to
two years imprisonment and expelled for two years from certain
cities. In 1920 her mother died. In 1923 Kravchenko left for
Perm where her father then resided and she then obtained
employment as a ballet dancer. In 1929 she left with an
impresario named Amirago for Turkestan and visited several towns
in that country. In December 1930 she left for Vladivostok
where she was employed in a State Theatre and also appeared in
Habarovsk and Blagoveshensk theatres. In November 1931 she
escaped from U.S.S.R. aided by some men hired by Fokin and
proceeded to Harbin where she worked in several theatres.
There is nothing in Police records to the detriment
of Fokin and Kravchenko.

她的父母前往喀山，她的父亲在那里的一所神学院学习。1916年，她随父母前往高加索地区的巴库，她的父亲被调往该地。1917年，由于健康状况不佳，她随母亲前往俄罗斯北部的沃洛格达（Vologda），但在内战开始后返回彼尔姆（Perm）。1918年，她的父亲被捕，被判两年监禁，并被禁止进入某些城市两年。1920年，她的母亲去世。1923年，克拉夫琴科前往彼尔姆，当时她的父亲居住在那里，她随后找到了一份芭蕾舞演员的工作。1929年，她随一位名叫阿米拉戈（Amirago）的经理人前往突厥斯坦，并访问了该国的几个城镇。1930年12月，她前往符拉迪沃斯托克，在那里受雇于一家国家剧院，并在哈巴罗夫斯克（Habarovsk）和布拉戈维申斯克（Blagoveshensk）的剧院演出。1931年11月，她在福金雇佣的一些人的帮助下逃离苏联，前往哈尔滨，在那里她在几家剧院工作。
警方档案中没有任何对福金和克拉夫琴科不利的记录。

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, JUNE 19, 1932
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 5502
25/6/32

FAMOUS RUSSIAN
DANCERS
Reach Shanghai After
Exciting Runaway
From Soviet

"Fokien and Kravchenko" have arrived in Shanghai following a thrilling escape from Soviet Russia, where their appearances in the largest academical theatres in Moscow and Leningrad have always been accompanied by great success.

For a long time Fokien and his beautiful partner Miss Kravchenko desired to go abroad, where they would have opportunities to repeat the successes they had experienced in their Homeland, but the authorities refused to visa their passports. After waiting a period of two years, they gave up hope of obtaining legal permission to leave Soviet Russia and decided to escape. Following many futile attempts, they at last succeeded in crossing the Manchuria border on foot, walking by night and hiding by day. Their story being eagerly listened to by kindhearted country folk they were fed by willing hands.

Their first appearance in their new world, was in Harbin where they were acclaimed as artists of extraordinary ability. Fokien and Miss Kravchenko will soon appear locally and "Shanghai theatregoers will have an opportunity of seeing them perform. Their appearance is anticipated with keen interest in the local theatrical world.

著名俄国
舞蹈家
在惊险逃离
苏联后抵达上海

“福金和克拉夫琴科”在惊险逃离苏维埃俄罗斯后抵达上海，他们在莫斯科和列宁格勒最大的学术剧院的演出总是伴随着巨大的成功。

长期以来，福金和他美丽的搭档克拉夫琴科小姐一直希望出国，在那里他们将有机会重现他们在祖国经历的成功，但当局拒绝在他们的护照上签证。在等待了两年之后，他们放弃了获得合法离开苏维埃俄罗斯许可的希望，并决定逃跑。经过多次徒劳的尝试，他们最终成功地步行穿越了满洲边界，夜间行走，白天躲藏。他们的故事被好心的乡亲们急切地倾听，并得到了热情的款待。

他们在新世界的首次亮相是在哈尔滨，在那里他们被誉为具有非凡才能的艺术家。福金和克拉夫琴科小姐即将在本地上演，“上海戏剧观众将有机会观看他们的表演。本地戏剧界对他们的出现寄予厚望。
